item.text:
The report now documents twenty-four reproduced findings at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md).

This continuation added **F24: `ZKDatabase.truncateLog(zxid)` retains snapshots and transactions newer than the target**. With a snapshot at zxid 7 and a transaction at zxid 8, `truncateLog(5)` left both `/snapshot-7` and `/txn-8` in the restored database:

```
after truncateLog(5): snapshot7=true, txn8=true
AssertionError: truncateLog(5) retained data newer than zxid 5
```

The production path clears the database, truncates only the transaction log, and reloads snapshots without removing newer snapshot files. Reproduction: [TruncateNonzeroDbRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/truncate_nonzero_db/TruncateNonzeroDbRepro.java).

This generalizes the empty-leader `TRUNC(0)` issue to nonzero truncation targets. The report’s artifact index, summary, and counts were updated to twenty-four findings. All reproduction programs and outputs remain under `repro/`; the captured source was not modified.
